title: aster iodochrous
intro: Aster iodochrous, commonly known as the Chinese daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aster iodochrous include promoting digestion, relieving fever, and soothing coughs, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and supplements. The bioactive constituents of Aster iodochrous include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
